translations.web: The priest shall burn them on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma; all the fat is Yahweh’s.
translations.bsb: Then the priest is to burn the food on the altar as a food offering, a pleasing aroma. All the fat is the LORD’s.
translations.kjv: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat is the LORD'S.
translations.asv: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a sweet savor; all the fat is Jehovah's.
